# Shruti 1.4.8
- Starts with a focused automatic mixer: Claude/ChatGPT, browsers, MuseScore, DAWs and live music hosts, instead of filling the panel with every application that might play. - Adds a visible Remove control to every app row, plus a destructive context-menu action. - Returns a removed app to untouched direct audio and clears its saved level, effects, redirect, favorite, lane and ducking references so no invisible processing survives. - Keeps removal durable across app restarts, Mac restarts and SoundSource imports. - Makes Add App show explicit Add, Remove and Restore states, with search covering known playback apps and applications Shruti has genuinely heard before. - Preserves deterministic manual ordering; LIVE state never moves a row.
